reviewMode: source-first; frozen before candidate edge comparison in this continuation
coordinateSystem: top-down original PDF points; raw source, not rectified pages
scope: All 56 raw changed crops. Shared headings/rehearsals/navigation handled by existing verified metadata; p28 s2 Da Capo owner expansion must remain separately. Guards carry small visual margins, so geometry failure is a review flag, not automatically missing black pixels.

guards.description: All notes/rests, high articulation dot, phrase slurs, low notes and final staccato dot.
High phrase slurs, clef/key, all notes and low ledger notes, tenuto marks, forte/pianissimo and hairpins.
Whole-bar rests throughout, clef/key and sloping right staff end; no viola dynamics printed here.
High ledger notes and accents at right, triplets/slurs, all notes/rests, middle low beams.
Upper long phrase slurs, all chord tones/low notes, dynamics and lower hairpins. Shared Andante heading is separate direction metadata.
Upper long phrase slur, all low notes/slurs, dim/p/pp dynamics and final fermata.
Upper slurs, all notes/accidentals/low ledger notes, dim. ed un poco rit. and final hairpin.
All notes/rests, upper slurs, low note slur, hairpins and forte.
Printed arco and pizz., all notes/chords, low notes, forte/dim. and final accent.
